design.model: Guilbaud-Pham mean criterion with running quadratic inventory penalty

controls.limit_quotes: none, current best, or improve current best by one legal tick on each side
controls.market_order: inventory-reducing impulse, enabled only for gp_qvi

paper_parameter_mapping.gamma_scaling: inventory measured in 100-share lots; coefficient is HKD-equivalent per lot^2-second

calibration.lambda_t: spread changes / observed seconds in six intraday buckets
calibration.execution_intensity: fills / time at risk by side, quote level, spread state and fill mode

execution.new_fill_logic: earliest qualifying future trade price OR opposite L1 best quote
execution.through: requires one actual daily tick beyond the order price

strategies.gp_qvi: paper-form GP policy with limit and inventory-reducing market orders
strategies.gp_qvi_womo: same solved GP policy with market-order impulse disabled
strategies.constant_best: paper benchmark: one lot at current best bid and ask
